checkpointSelection: Use the final update for all comparisons.
primaryMetric: Strict episode success on all twenty paired test scenarios.
secondaryMetric: Total verified on-time units divided by total committed units.
reward: On-time unit fraction plus 0.5 for strict success, less 0.02 times budget fraction spent and 0.002 per rejected action.
menu: Up to two booking choices per yard, a stock inquiry, a route or supplier inquiry, one purchase and a clock advance. Quantities come from observable stock, capacity, uncommitted demand and budget.
